tool_schemas.name: tavily-search
tool_schemas.description: Runs a web search for the provided query, stores the request under the optional workspace_id, and returns up to max_results hits (1–50) in a single response, optionally including a synthesized answer, raw/snippet content, and image results based on include_* flags. This endpoint is not paged; if more than max_results matches exist, only the top max_results are returned. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if required fields are missing/invalid (e.g., bad dates, max_results out of range, invalid workspace_id, or additional properties present), UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot access the referenced workspace_id, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if the workspace/account has insufficient remaining search capacity for the requested depth/features.

query.description: Search query text to run against the web.

search_depth.description: Search depth/quality level to use for retrieval.

max_results.description: Maximum number of search hits to return.

include_answer.description: Whether to include a synthesized answer in the response.

include_raw_content.description: Whether to include raw page content/snippets for returned hits.

include_images.description: Whether to include image results when available.

include_domains.description: Restrict results to these allowed domains.

start_date.description: Only include results published on/after this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

end_date.description: Only include results published on/before this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

workspace_id.description: Workspace id to attribute and store the tool call under.

tool_schemas.name: tavily-extract
tool_schemas.description: Fetches and extracts content from the provided list of URLs, storing the request under the optional workspace_id, and returns one extracted result per URL (with optional raw content and images) with extracted text truncated to max_chars when provided. Results are returned in a single response and are not paginated. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for an empty/invalid urls list, invalid URL formats, invalid workspace_id, max_chars < 1, or unknown fields, UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot use the referenced workspace_id, NOT_FOUND when a URL cannot be retrieved or no extractable document is available at that location, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED when the workspace/account lacks sufficient extraction capacity for the number of URLs and requested depth/features.

urls.description: List of URLs to fetch and extract content from.

include_raw_content.description: Whether to include the raw fetched content in the extracted output.

include_images.description: Whether to include image URLs/metadata when available.

extract_depth.description: Extraction thoroughness level (e.g., boilerplate removal, richer parsing).

max_chars.description: Maximum number of characters of extracted text content to return per URL.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id to attribute and store the tool call under.

tool_schemas.name: tavily-crawl
tool_schemas.description: Creates and stores a crawl job starting from the base url and returns the crawl job record and initial crawl metadata for the given workspace_id (if provided), with traversal constrained by max_depth (0–10), max_pages (1–1000), domain/path allow/deny lists, allow_external, and respect_robots_txt. This endpoint does not page results; the crawl continues until completion or limits are reached, and discovered pages/content are persisted for later retrieval. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid URL/limits, contradictory or malformed include/exclude filters, invalid workspace_id, or unknown fields, UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot access the workspace, CONFLICT if an incompatible crawl is already in progress for the same workspace and start URL, NOT_FOUND if the base URL cannot be reached to start the crawl, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if the workspace/account does not have enough crawl capacity for the requested limits and options.

url.description: Base URL to start crawling from.

max_depth.description: Maximum link depth to traverse from the base URL.

max_pages.description: Maximum number of pages to crawl before stopping.

include_domains.description: Restrict crawling to these domains (if provided).

exclude_domains.description: Do not crawl pages from these domains.

include_paths.description: Only crawl URLs whose path starts with one of these prefixes.

exclude_paths.description: Do not crawl URLs whose path starts with one of these prefixes.

allow_external.description: Whether to allow following external links beyond the base domain.

respect_robots_txt.description: Whether to obey robots.txt directives during crawling.

include_raw_content.description: Whether to store/return raw content for crawled pages.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id to attribute and store the tool call under.

tool_schemas.name: tavily-map
tool_schemas.description: Creates and stores a site-mapping job for the base url and returns the map job record and initial graph/discovery metadata, constrained by max_depth (0–10), max_urls (1–5000), domain/path allow/deny lists, and respect_robots_txt, under the optional workspace_id. This endpoint does not page results; URL discovery stops when max_urls/max_depth are reached or discovery completes, and the resulting URL graph is persisted for later retrieval and auditing. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid URL/limits, malformed include/exclude filters, invalid workspace_id, or unknown fields, UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot use the workspace, CONFLICT if an incompatible mapping job is already in progress for the same workspace and base URL, NOT_FOUND if the base URL cannot be reached to seed discovery, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if the workspace/account lacks sufficient mapping capacity for the requested limits and options.

url.description: Base URL of the site to map.

max_depth.description: Maximum depth of URL discovery from the base URL.

max_urls.description: Maximum number of URLs/nodes to include in the site map.

include_domains.description: Restrict mapping to these domains (if provided).

include_paths.description: Only include URLs whose path starts with one of these prefixes.

exclude_paths.description: Exclude URLs whose path starts with one of these prefixes.

respect_robots_txt.description: Whether to obey robots.txt while discovering URLs.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id to attribute and store the tool call under.

tool_schemas.name: tavily-whoami
tool_schemas.description: Returns the authenticated identity for the presented Tavily API key, including the resolved workspace, granted scopes/entitlements, and current month usage counters/limits. Refuses requests with missing/invalid/expired keys.

api_key.description: Tavily API key used to authenticate the request (sent as provided by the client).

workspace_id.description: Optional workspace to resolve identity against when the key has access to multiple workspaces.

tool_schemas.name: tavily-tool-calls-list
tool_schemas.description: Lists stored tool call job records for the authenticated workspace, with optional filtering by tool_name, status, and time range. Returns a paginated list ordered by requested_at desc. Refuses requests when the workspace is not active or the api_key does not belong to the workspace.

api_key.description: Tavily API key used to authenticate the request.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id whose tool calls to list.

tool_name.description: Filter to a single tool name.

status.description: Filter to tool calls currently in this status.

from_requested_at.description: Only include tool calls requested at or after this timestamp (RFC 3339).

to_requested_at.description: Only include tool calls requested at or before this timestamp (RFC 3339).

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return per page.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response.

tool_schemas.name: tavily-tool-calls-get
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single stored tool call job record by id, including its persisted input/normalized_input and operational metadata. Refuses access if the tool call does not belong to the authenticated workspace.

api_key.description: Tavily API key used to authenticate the request.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id that must own the tool call.

tool_schemas.name: tavily-tool-call-results-list
tool_schemas.description: Lists stored results/documents/graph rows produced by a tool call (search hits, extracted documents, crawl pages, map nodes/edges). Returns a paginated list ordered by (kind, rank, created_at). Refuses requests if the tool call is not in the authenticated workspace.

api_key.description: Tavily API key used to authenticate the request.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id that must own the tool call.

tool_call_id.description: Tool call id whose results to list.

kind.description: Filter results to a single kind.

limit.description: Maximum number of result rows to return per page.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response.

tool_schemas.name: tavily-tool-calls-update
tool_schemas.description: Updates a stored tool call job record. Primarily used by workers to drive lifecycle transitions (queued→running→succeeded/failed/cancelled/expired) while enforcing valid transitions and required timestamps. Refuses invalid transitions, attempts to set finished_at before started_at, or writes from an api_key outside the tool call’s workspace.

api_key.description: Tavily API key used to authenticate the request.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id that must own the tool call.

status.description: New lifecycle status for the tool call. Must be a valid transition from the current status.

error_code.description: Optional machine-readable failure reason when setting status=failed/cancelled/expired.

error_message.description: Optional human-readable failure details when setting status=failed/cancelled/expired.

started_at.description: When the tool call started running. Required when transitioning to status=running; ignored otherwise.

finished_at.description: When the tool call finished. Required when transitioning to status in {succeeded,failed,cancelled,expired}.

expires_at.description: Optional expiration timestamp for retention/expiry behavior.

billed_tokens.description: Billed token count to persist on success. When provided with status=succeeded, backend applies monthly usage increments atomically.

tool_schemas.name: tavily-workspaces-get
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a workspace by id including plan and current-month request/token usage and limits for quota enforcement/auditing. Refuses access if the api_key is not in the workspace.

api_key.description: Tavily API key used to authenticate the request.
